ic1102b-W5: What’s starving them is anomie. We evolved to live in small groups where everybody knows, loves, and trusts everybody. In a large society, the shared norms and close ties that held those groups together fall apart. Nobody knows anybody well enough, or for long enough, to tell who can be trusted. Even your next-door neighbor is often a total stranger. That’s how large societies end up run by psychopaths. (Yes, I’m always going on about this.)
